seed_authority.edition: MICHELIN Guide American South, inaugural edition

why_this_city: Camp Phebe, Asheville, July 2027. Goal: by camp week, Asheville is the most legible city in the world for eating out on a low-protein diet.
notes: Seed set is the Michelin 15 because it is a closed, citable, externally-defined list. It is a starting frame, not a claim that Michelin recognition predicts PKU accommodation. Expansion beyond the 15 is expected. The Admiral and Ukiah Japanese Smokehouse are in the 15; Leo's House of Thirst is a third, separate restaurant.
